whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: This is the first of my Holodion series. I call it Space Graffiti Whipped Cream. It was a new place to create a performance. Here I am flying as Daughter of Icarus, which followed Space Graffiti in 1972 and 73. These were the first of seven 360 integral holograms, which I named Holodion series. A variation on my performance is three objects. Each one is different in color and it's also in its neighbor's space. Space Graffiti This is Tired Liberty, done in 1975 for the Bicentennial celebration. Little did I realize how really tired she was.
